lines.text: The writer calls to mind that because of the LORD's loving devotion we are not consumed, and His mercies are new every morning.
His soul calls the LORD his fortress, and the LORD is good to those who wait for Him.
A man should bear the yoke while young, sit alone in silence because the LORD laid it upon him, and bury his face in the dust.
The Lord will not cast us off forever, and even if He causes grief, He will show anger according to His abundant loving devotion.
The Lord does not approve of crushing prisoners or denying justice, and both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High.
